newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins lower on US Treasuries decline.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins lower on US Treasuries decline.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds eased on Monday after Friday's decline in U.S. Treasuries and emerging markets, and the market had not fully recovered from the New Year holidays, dealers said.
"Few deals were made through the day. Prices have edged down seemingly due to Friday's fall of U.S. Treasuries," an International Moscow Bank dealer said.
Dealers said the most actively traded fourth tranche had met support at 60.00-60.15.
"People are not sure the U.S. paper will stand firm, so all fixed income papers went down," a Moscow Narodny Bank dealer said.

Dealers said almost all Western banks were seen back on the market after the New Year holidays, while some Russian banks stayed on the sidelines for the Orthodox Christmas holiday in Russia on Tuesday January 7.
